svg.text: Where the best electrode design sits in salt starvation: r_kt against 100-cycle DFN energy
grey: 33 seen conditions; colour: fresh (Sobol seed 13); rings: each pool's DFN@100 best.
Designs left of the dashed line (r_kt < -0.2) are dropped before any DFN run.
r_kt (closed-form minimum salt ratio; clipped at -2)
